name: wildcard-permitted-far-outer-too-broad-invalid
description: A single-label wildcard SAN (*.com) is far too broad for a deep permitted subtree (foo.example.com) and must be rejected.
references: Go name_constraints_test "far outer wildcard names are not matched by subdomain permitted constraints"
notes: RFC 5280 does not define wildcard SAN semantics; this targets Go's application DNS-ID name-constraint behavior.
